name: Byron Donalds
bio: a Representative from Florida; born in Brooklyn, Kings County, N.Y., October 28, 1978; graduated from Nazareth Regional High School, Brooklyn, N.Y., 1996; attended Florida A&M University, Tallahassee, Fla., 1996-1999; B.A., Florida State University, Tallahassee, Fla., 2002; financial advisor; member of the Florida state house of representatives, 2016-2020; unsuccessful candidate for nomination to the One Hundred Thirteenth Congress in 2012; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2021-present).
